canonical_equations: Repeated RN32 powers up/vp; degree-ascending then p-ascending sums of RN32(RN32(coef*up[p])*vp[q]);U=RN32(u+A),V=RN32(v+B). Every rounded step explicit.
input_contract: Finite binary32-hex offsets[N,2] in[-1024,1024],N1..4096; independent integer a_order/b_order2..5; complete degree-ascending p-ascending coefficient arrays,abs(coef)<=2^(8-10*degree); explicit reference-relative pixel units,model id and exact fields.
output_contract: N x4 binary32[U,V,A_correction,B_correction],all in pixel offset units;full zero-bit output validation;no coefficient fitting,CD stage,inverse or invertibility/calibration promise.
result_contract: N x4 binary32[U,V,A_correction,B_correction],all in pixel offset units;full zero-bit output validation;no coefficient fitting,CD stage,inverse or invertibility/calibration promise.
precision_requirements: Finite IEEE binary32 values, explicitly supplied as eight hex digits (encoding=binary32-hex). Every +,-,*,/,sqrt rounds to nearest ties-to-even; gradual underflow; canonical positive zero after arithmetic. No FMA or reassociation. Nonfinite inputs, intermediate overflow, division by zero and invalid roots reject the job on CPU before dispatch. Bit identity is to this specified rounded algorithm, not exact real arithmetic or other library reduction orders.
validation_method: Full byte comparison against independent exact-rational RN32 CPU oracle; analytic, adversarial and held-out vectors; arithmetic tested separately.
